lines.t: When they ask me, “What church do you belong to?”
I belong to The Lord, YahuShua HaMashiach,
The One you call Jesus, the Christ.
I walk in His love, I obey His voice, Together with those who do the same.
That’s The Church where I dwell…
No building, no title, no creed can contain,
The Spirit that moves in His Holy name.
I’m bound by His mercy, redeemed by His blood,
United in faith, and sealed with His love.
Not named of men, not made by hands
Only His Spirit helps me stand.
Together with those who are His
Thats The church i belong to
